title: Theme and chart, decoupled
subtitle: One DOM, one token swap per theme. Conclusions first, then process, impact, and acceptance.

items.title: Tokens are the skin
items.text: Themes may only override --t-* variables; a literal color fails the build.

items.title: Structure is the contract
items.text: Nine chart layouts share one DOM fingerprint across every theme.

items.title: Bilingual by construction
items.text: Chinese and English fixtures share the DOM; only the copy differs.

items.title: Atomic restyling
items.text: restyle swaps the theme block and leaves every other byte untouched.

sections.title: How the proof runs, four steps

items.label: Extract
items.text: Split the chart DOM from its theme block.

items.label: Tokens
items.text: Collapse styling into one named contract.

items.label: Restyle
items.text: Apply each of the five themes to one DOM.

items.label: Verify
items.text: Identical fingerprints pass; any drift fails.

sections.title: Risk and dependency
sections.text: The token contract is the only boundary. The proof covers static layout only, not animation or responsive behavior.
